summary: A background pass whose answer is longer than a chat reply is no longer cut off mid-sentence and retried forever.
details: The Dreamer's passes now get their own per-call output ceiling, set with [dreamer] max_tokens, instead of silently inheriting the one sized for Nora's own replies in a room.
Leaving it unset changes nothing: it still inherits, exactly as before.
One room had spent roughly a day in this state — every pass over it cut off, nothing written, the same backlog re-read once an hour — with 1,250 messages waiting behind it.
limitations: A pass whose answer cannot fit its ceiling still retries indefinitely rather than giving up or shrinking what it reads; that is tracked separately and is not fixed here.
The new ceiling is headroom, not a measured size — how much one of these passes actually needs has not been measured yet.
